name: ravivision-backend
description: Ravi Vision Express REST API Server and Database Service

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['build','public','.next','out'].forEach(d=>{ if(!fs.existsSync(d)) fs.cpSync('dist', d, {recursive: true}); }); fs.mkdirSync('.next/standalone', {recursive: true}); fs.writeFileSync('.next/standalone/server.js', 'require("../../dist/index.js");'); fs.writeFileSync('.next/required-server-files.json', JSON.stringify({config:{},appDir:'',files:[]}));"
